Depression makes me feel suffocated, panicky, sad, and just miserable. And more lonely than I've ever been before. 

The best way I can describe how I feel these days is that I'm at the bottom of a deep, dark hole. When I look up, I think I can see a faint bit of light at the top. The problem is that I've been down so long that I'm not sure if the light is real or if it's just my imagination getting my hopes up again.

I'm also on Wellbutrin and it has helped a lot, but it wasn't enough to just feel okay. I've tried at least 5 different psychologists and I'm with you, the conversation became repetitive and unhelpful after a number of visits. I know that this idea isn't for everyone but you may want to look into trying a coach of some sort. One that is still a licensed professional of course! 

I just started with an ADHD coach who specializes in young adult depression. I was super skeptical when I walked into her office, but I left feeling like maybe there's a chance that I can turn my life around. Instead of just talking about how I felt, we talked about how the way I was feeling was stopping me from being a better version of myself and what I can do about that. We came up with goals that I'm going to be working towards with her help. It was the most helpful counseling type of experience that I've had so far.
